hypothesis: Market signal review: the AI-security bottleneck has moved from 'AI writes sloppy reports' to 'humans cannot triage the volume of high-quality AI findings' (curl maintainer 22 Oct 07:00Z: slop essentially gone since spring 2026, the hard part is bug-vs-vulnerability and severity; Trail of Bits 'Patch the Planet': finding the bugs is now the easy part, maintainers must sift AI output to separate real vulnerabilities from plausible-sounding false positives; AISLE: one autonomous curl audit produced 24 CVEs, 18 shipped). Therefore the wedge is post-hoc TRIAGE EVIDENCE, not finding and not prevention: a receipt per finding binding (a) the provenance class of the transcript that produced it, (b) a re-derivable repro artifact plus hash, and (c) the effect hash of the fix, so a human triager can accept or reject without trusting the model or the vendor. Test: 30 labelled agent-generated findings classified with a published confusion matrix and refusal rate, plus external re-derivation. Kill if no outside party re-derives in 72h.

diff_from_prev_cycle: Cycle 16 held lane #5 (provenance class of the source transcript) and promised the probe artifact 'this cycle even if nothing else does'. This cycle (17) DELIVERS it: artifacts/provenance-probe exists, passes, and publishes three numbers (corpus 120 with 1.0 refusal / 0.0 false-accept; 40 foreign harness logs structure-sensitive; our own laundering rate 0.051%). It also corrects cycle 16's internal story: the 355 daily duplicate diagnoses are an unbounded re-diagnosis loop over two dead missions, not 355 laundering events - our provenance rate is 0.05%, so the fleet's real disease is wasted triage capacity, not laundering. Externally, the lane rotates one notch up: the forcing signals moved from 'provenance of evidence' to 'admissibility of findings' (curl maintainer: slop gone, triage is the hard part; Trail of Bits: finding is easy, sifting is the bottleneck; AISLE: 24 CVEs from one autonomous audit), so the deliverable becomes a receipt that binds provenance class + repro artifact hash + effect hash of the fix. Competitor read closes on Agent Middleware (signed permits/receipts, offline-verifiable, closest live rival) whose own README concedes receipts cannot prove a remote effect - that concession is our v0.2 wedge.
